narration_line: Every morning Mei's grandmother cuts a notch in a bamboo stick, and every morning the sky stays empty.
The wells of Bamboo Ridge Village are almost dry, the rice seedlings are turning yellow, and the rain-asking at the shrine has failed.
Then someone remembers the old story of the dragon of Black Pool, high on the mountain.

column16: Mei, who freezes whenever she has to speak up, is the only one who says, "I'll go."

location: narrow dirt path through bamboo forest
column16: With her chatty little brother in yellow rain boots, a know-it-all classmate who is secretly afraid of heights, and a patient water buffalo, she climbs through bamboo, over a rope bridge and into the clouds.

location: wooden plank and rope bridge over a misty gorge

column17: At the top she finds a dragon who is kind, polite and absolutely terrified of his own thunder.

location: stone shrine yard of a mountain village

sky_weather: soft grey rain clouds with misty sky
